description: Source code for the TeamService in Mattermost, managing team creation, retrieval, updates, user membership, and default channels.

classes.name: UpdateOptions
classes.description: Options for updating a team, indicating whether the update is sanitized or imported.

methods.name: CreateTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team, initializes default channels, and returns the created team.

methods.name: GetTeam
methods.description: Retrieves a team by its ID.

methods.name: GetTeams
methods.description: Retrieves multiple teams by their IDs.

methods.name: createDefaultChannels
methods.description: Creates default channels ('town-square' and 'off-topic') for a team.

methods.name: UpdateTeam
methods.description: Updates team properties based on provided options, including validation.

methods.name: PatchTeam
methods.description: Applies a patch to a team, updating specific fields.

methods.name: JoinUserToTeam
methods.description: Adds a user to a team, creating a team member record, handling admin roles, and email restrictions.

methods.name: RemoveTeamMember
methods.description: Removes a team member, sending websocket events before deletion.

methods.name: GetMember
methods.description: Retrieves a team member by team and user IDs.
